payload.title: FIX-AUDITOR-COMMIT-MUTEX-SKIP
payload.summary: system-auditor T1 notebook commit executed WITHOUT paired commit-mutex claim — 2nd occurrence, drift-watch threshold hit (2nd skip => P2 repair). Flow mandates task_claim(task_kind=commit-mutex) around the notebook commit; runs at 2026-07-02T23:00Z and 23:30Z paired correctly (e.g. 0b4f49e88), runs at 2026-07-02T22:44Z and 2026-07-03T00:14Z skipped — non-deterministic flow adherence.

evidence.occurrence_1: 2026-07-02T22:44Z T1 notebook commit, no commit-mutex claim in transcript
evidence.occurrence_2: 2026-07-03T00:14Z commit 11be6d74d (transcript a5c76babeb72ea425): gateway calls = cron:auditor-t1 claim x2 + get_system_status + get_cron_health + release — zero commit-mutex activity

payload.risk: unserialized agent commits race the shared git index (known concurrent-commit-race class); mutex exists to serialize notebook commits against router/dev-team commits
payload.proposed_fix: harden docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md commit step: route the notebook commit through a single blessed script that claims/releases the commit-mutex internally, so the mutex cannot be skipped by flow-step drift; add explicit RAW-verifiable marker line
